shots.action: Through the side window of a bus at night, rain begins to run down the glass in uneven threads; beyond it, city lights sit far out of focus as soft colored smears against the dark. Inside the bus the cabin is dim and empty of visible passengers, and the window frame and part of a seat back hold the lower edge of the frame. The camera holds perfectly still while the first drops crawl downward, gathering and breaking apart.
shots.what_changes: The glass shifts from lightly spattered to streaked as the first raindrops begin running down it.

subjects: a single large raindrop on the bus window glass
the wavering wet trail beneath it
the distorted blurred lights seen through the water
sync_sound: a soft tick as droplets merge against the glass
steady rain murmuring outside the bus
shots.action: The camera cuts to a close, locked view of the glass itself, where a single fat droplet swells, trembles, then slides, dragging a wavering clear trail behind it. It collides with a second droplet and absorbs it, briefly doubling in size before continuing downward, and the blurred lights behind warp and stretch in the wet channel it leaves. The framing does not move; only the water and the distorted light change.
shots.what_changes: One droplet gathers, slides, merges with a second and grows, reshaping the blurred lights behind it.

subjects: the bus window and the empty seat beside it
the smeared night lights and a faint interior reflection
sync_sound: rain streaming and ticking against the window
the quiet muffled hum of the bus
shots.action: The shot cuts to a medium wide view of the window and the empty seat beside it, both held motionless in the frame while rain keeps sheeting down and the blurred night lights slide and smear through the wet glass. Droplets race each other diagonally across the pane, joining into thicker rivulets at the lower edge, and the reflection of the dim cabin light sits faintly on the inside of the glass. Nothing else in the frame moves.
shots.what_changes: The window fills with many simultaneous rivulets that thicken along the lower edge as the rain intensifies, while the seat and cabin stay still.

description.text: At night, seen through the side glass of a bus, rain begins to dot the pane. Beyond the water, city lights break into soft, unfocused smears of amber, white and faint red in the dark. The lower frame holds a strip of dark window rubber and the top edge of a seat back inside the dim, empty cabin. The first drops bead on the outside of the glass, gathering into small uneven pearls before they start to crawl downward, each leaving a thin, wavering line. The rain remains light at first, so the streaks appear one by one while the out-of-focus lights stay nearly still behind them. Inside the bus, the surfaces are matte and shadowed, with only the faintest sheen along the window frame and seat edge. The glass slowly changes from lightly spattered to marked by the first running threads of water.
Rain speckles the dark bus window at night, with blurred city lights beyond and the dim cabin frame and seat back below.
Rain patters softly against the glass while a low, muffled bus interior hum fills the cabin.
The first droplets gather and begin to run down the outside of the pane in fine wavering threads.
The rain ticks lightly against the window as the first streaks lengthen.
The camera holds a static shot.

The view is close on the wet glass, where a single large raindrop trembles at the center of the pane. It swells until its lower edge bulges, then breaks free and slides downward, hauling a clear channel that bends the blurred lights behind it into long, wavering streaks. Partway down, it meets a smaller drop; the two merge with a soft pulse, and the enlarged bead continues, fattening and slowing as it gathers more water. Around it, thinner droplets hang in place or slip a short distance before stalling. The reflected glow from the cabin smears across the wet surface, while the night lights beyond are stretched and broken by every new turn of the channel. The glass and the water remain the whole field of view, with no other object entering the frame.
A close view of the rain-streaked glass shows a large central droplet, finer beads around it and distorted lights beyond.
A steady murmur of rain continues outside the bus, close and soft against the glass.
A single large droplet swells, trembles, and begins to slide, dragging a wavering trail.
The sliding drop meets a smaller one and absorbs it, briefly doubling in size as it continues downward.
A soft tick sounds as droplets merge against the glass.
The camera holds a static shot.

The view widens again to include the window and the empty seat beside it, both held in the dim interior. Rain now sheets down the glass in many parallel threads, some racing diagonally before joining into thicker rivulets along the lower edge. The blurred night lights slide and smear through the wet pane, while a faint reflection of the cabin light rests on the inside surface near the top of the frame. The seat remains vacant, its dark upholstery picking up a weak highlight from the window. Droplets continue to collide and split, and the lower channel of water thickens as the rain intensifies. Nothing in the cabin shifts; only the moving water and the distorted lights change across the glass.
The rain-covered bus window and the empty seat beside it are visible in the dim cabin, with blurred night lights beyond the glass.
Rain streams and ticks against the window over the quiet muffled hum of the bus.
Many droplets race diagonally across the pane, joining into thick rivulets along the lower edge.
The rain intensifies into a denser patter against the glass.
The camera holds a static shot.

document.soundscape: Soft rain pattering and ticking against glass, with a low muffled bus interior hum.
